resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review metadata, queue validation, typecheck, 79 test files with 462 tests, complete build, 39 IIS rules with 61 route cases, and 724 generated-link checks passed.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Nynorsk pass identified 25 actionable Bokmål residues, mixed-language instructions, and one factual wording defect across electrical, circuit, trigonometric, thermal, and unit-conversion content; all 25 were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted.

findings.summary: The unchanged-resistance bullet retained the Bokmål forms øker and strømmen.
evidence: The previous sentence said ‘Når motstanden er uendret, øker strømmen når spenningen øker.’
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk forms uendra, aukar, straumen, and spenninga.

findings.summary: The unchanged-voltage bullet retained Bokmål forms for voltage, current, and increase.
evidence: The previous sentence said ‘Når spenningen er uendret, synker strømmen når motstanden øker.’
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Når spenninga er uendra, søkk straumen når motstanden aukar.’

findings.summary: The resistance example used the Bokmål noun kretsen.
evidence: The previous conclusion was ‘Motstanden i kretsen er 6 Ω.’
findings.resolution: Changed kretsen to the Nynorsk form krinsen.

findings.summary: The voltage example conclusion used the Bokmål form Spenningen.
evidence: The previous conclusion was ‘Spenningen er 5 V.’
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk form ‘Spenninga er 5 V.’

findings.summary: The unit-conversion title was written in Bokmål.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Enhetsomregning’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Omrekning av einingar’.

findings.summary: The unit-conversion instruction was entirely Bokmål.
evidence: The previous instruction was ‘Hold enhetene konsistente før du regner:’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Hald einingane konsistente før du reknar:’.

findings.summary: The model-limitations title used the Bokmål compound begrensninger.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Modellens begrensninger’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the concise Nynorsk title ‘Modellavgrensingar’.

findings.summary: The Joule-heating summary incorrectly said that current transforms resistance into heat.
evidence: The previous summary said ‘Korleis elektrisk straum omdannar motstand til varme.’
findings.resolution: Replaced resistance with the correct physical source: electrical energy becomes heat when current passes through a resistor.

findings.summary: The constant-resistance bullet retained the Bokmål verb gir.
evidence: The previous sentence began ‘Ved konstant motstand gir ei dobling ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed gir to the Nynorsk form gjev.

findings.summary: The heat-transfer bullet mixed Bokmål faktisk with Nynorsk content.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with ‘den faktiske temperaturen’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk wording ‘den verkelege temperaturen’.

findings.summary: The voltage-law explanation retained the Bokmål verb gir.
evidence: The previous paragraph said ‘Ein større seriemotstand gir eit større spenningsfall’.
findings.resolution: Changed gir to gjev while preserving the circuit explanation.

findings.summary: The parallel-cell bullet used a Bokmål passive construction.
evidence: The previous sentence ended with ‘kapasitet og tilgjengeleg straum om lag blir summert’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the natural Nynorsk form ‘blir lagde saman’.

findings.summary: The degrees-to-radians formula used the Bokmål plural radians.
evidence: The previous expression was ‘180° = π radians’.
findings.resolution: Changed the unit word to the Nynorsk form radianar.

findings.summary: The waveform title used Bokmål bølgeformer and identiteter.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Bølgeformer og nyttige identiteter’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Bølgjeformer og nyttige identitetar’.

findings.summary: The angular-frequency bullet used the Bokmål form måles.
evidence: The previous sentence was ‘Vinkelfrekvensen ω måles i radianer per sekund.’
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Vinkelfrekvensen ω blir målt i radianar per sekund.’

findings.summary: The heat-capacity example setup used the Bokmål noun vann.
evidence: The previous setup said ‘Varm opp 0,20 kg vann ...’.
findings.resolution: Changed vann to vatn.

findings.summary: The ideal-heating setup mixed Bokmål en with Nynorsk wording.
evidence: The previous setup said ‘med en konstant kilde på 100 W utan tap’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘med ei konstant kjelde på 100 W utan tap’.

findings.summary: The ideal-heating conclusion retained Bokmål tida and tiden.
evidence: The previous conclusion used ‘Den ideelle tiden ... er den omtrent 523 sekunder’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with the Nynorsk forms tida, minutt, and ho.

findings.summary: The phase-change title used the Bokmål compound Faseendringer.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Faseendringer og praktiske begrensninger’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Faseendringar og praktiske avgrensingar’.

findings.summary: The phase-change explanation used the Bokmål genitive materialets.
evidence: The previous paragraph said ‘endre materialets fase’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to the Nynorsk phrase ‘endre fasen til materialet’.

findings.summary: The SI-system description mixed Bokmål gir et, omregning, and måleverdier with Nynorsk terms.
evidence: The previous description began ‘SI-systemet gir et sammenhengende grunnlag ...’.
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with gjev eit, omrekning, and måleverdiar.

findings.summary: The other-conversions title used the Bokmål form omregninger.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Andre vanlege omregninger’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Andre vanlege omrekningar’.

findings.summary: The imperial-unit paragraph used English/Bokmål pound, en, størrelser, and tommer wording.
evidence: The previous paragraph began ‘En pound kan vise til masse ... som er ulike størrelser.’
findings.resolution: Rewrote it with the Nynorsk terms pund, eit, storleikar, and tommar.

findings.summary: The unit-check title used the Bokmål compound enhetskontroller.
evidence: The previous title was ‘Praktiske enhetskontroller’.
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Praktiske einingskontrollar’.

findings.summary: The first unit-check instruction was written in Bokmål.
evidence: The previous instruction was ‘Skriv enheten ved siden av hver verdi mens du regner.’
findings.resolution: Changed it to ‘Skriv eininga ved sida av kvar verdi medan du reknar.’
